content.text: Evidence is conclusive: the flag `monthly-spend-feature` flipped from `off` to `on` at the onset minute, with a partial ramp visible in that same minute, and the new error class appears exactly then.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was toggled from off to on at 2026-09-16T15:22:00Z. The newly enabled code path hit a ZeroDivisionError in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32 on account page requests, driving error rate from ~1% baseline to 15-35%.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
error_rate jumps from 0.005 at 15:21 to 0.155 at 15:22 and 0.32 at 15:23 with request_volume flat at 1200
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-09T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-16T15:30:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: latent bad code in spend_summary.py shipped by an earlier deployment and was only exposed when traffic began reaching it.
